name: pedigree-insights
description: Open-source, source-agnostic macOS analysis tool for pedigree SQLite databases (e.g. BreedMate .db). Read-only. Pedigree bracket chart, an Indented Tree text pedigree (exportable to .txt), Linebreeding crosses, and a Foundation-contribution report.
author: Yuliya Malinina <julia.malinina@gmail.com>

scripts.preversion: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "release: v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "release: v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "release: v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
